title: One deployable unit owns its data
context_and_drivers: A single write path keeps the latency scenario observable.
options: One deployable unit: one write path and one failure domain.
PostgreSQL per service: rejected here; a product name belongs in the technology record.
decision: One deployable unit owns its data and its write path.
consequences: A second unit needs a new ADR. Independent scaling is not available.
fitness_function: A dependency rule rejects a domain import of an adapter.
review_trigger: A second team needs to deploy on its own cadence.
